title: British Lamb Casserole
description: A hearty, traditional British casserole made with tender lamb and warm, malty flavors. Perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add the lamb and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside.
Reduce the heat to medium and add the onion to the pot. Cook until the onion is softened, about 5 minutes. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the flour to the pot and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the red wine, chicken broth, mushrooms, tomato paste, and thyme to the pot. Stir to combine.
Return the lamb to the pot and bring the mixture to a boil.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven. Bake for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly. Serve the casserole hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
